L105: 【37†Music Bank】 Chart winners (2025)
L106: ---
L107: The Music Bank Chart is a 【38†record chart】 established in 1998 on the South Korean 【39†KBS】 television 【40†music program】 【37†Music Bank】. Every week during its live broadcast, the show gives an award for the best-performing 【41†single】 on the South Korean chart.
L108: The chart utilizes digital performances on domestic online music services (60%), number of times the single was broadcast on KBS TV, radio and digital channels (20%), global pre-vote derived from Mubeat app (10%), album sales (5%), and social media score calculated using 【42†YouTube】 and 【43†TikTok】 data gathered from the 【44†Circle】 chart (5%) in its ranking methodology.^{【45†[1]】}^{【46†[2]】} The score for domestic online music services is calculated using data from 【47†Melon】, Bugs, 【48†Genie Music】, 【49†Naver VIBE】 and Flo.^{【50†[3]】} The show has been hosted by 【51†Park Min-ju】 and 【52†Moon Sang-min】 since October 2024.^{【53†[4]】}
